# Dongying Casting (Dongying Wanlong Mechanical Mould Co., Ltd.)

> Precision investment casting (lost-wax) and CNC machining manufacturer in Dongying, Shandong, China. Founded 2000. ISO 9001:2015 / GB/T 19001 and CE certified. Castings in superalloys, stainless steel, carbon steel and heat-resistant steel, made to customer drawings from a single prototype to series production.

## Company
- Legal name: Dongying Wanlong Mechanical Mould Co., Ltd. (东营万隆机械模具有限公司)
- Location: No. 17, Chuanghui Road, Niuzhuang Innovation Park, Dongying District, Dongying, Shandong, China
- Founded: 2000; 101–200 staff; ~5,000 m² factory; 21 CNC machining centres
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, GB/T 19001, CE, UN ECE R55 (type-approval mark E57·55R-03 0158)
- Export markets: 40+ countries; ports Qingdao, Shanghai, Tianjin, Dongying; Incoterms FOB/CIF/EXW
- Alibaba store: https://dywl.en.alibaba.com

## Product lines
- [Superalloy turbine components](https://dongying-casting.com/en/products/superalloy-turbine-components): Inconel NGV nozzle guide vanes, stator rings, hot-section parts, vacuum investment casting.
- [Pump impellers & housings](https://dongying-casting.com/en/products/pump-impellers-housings): 316L and ductile-iron impellers and SS316 pump casings.
- [Exhaust manifolds & headers](https://dongying-casting.com/en/products/exhaust-manifolds): stainless and high-temp-alloy turbo manifolds and racing headers.
- [Impellers & fan wheels](https://dongying-casting.com/en/products/impellers-fan-wheels): stainless steel impellers for turbomachinery, blowers and fans.
- [Casting moulds & prototypes](https://dongying-casting.com/en/products/casting-moulds-prototypes): wax-injection, die-casting and CNC prototype moulds in aluminium 6061/7075 and brass.

## Capabilities
- Processes: investment casting (lost-wax), vacuum and air-melt casting, CNC machining (4/5-axis, EDM, wire-cutting), in-house mould shop, 14 R&D engineers, 6 QC inspectors.
- Industries served: automotive, marine, oil & gas, agriculture, industrial machinery, construction, medical equipment.
